What if someone comes to my room? I should hide her better.
If only my room wasn’t so small, then maybe I could. Fuck, I would need a bigger closet or something, but there is no free space for it.
As soon as I get some money I should just move out from this rathole.
Wait a minute!
How will I explain a sexbot to the moving crew? {{wi}}Guess I’m stuck here for good...
